scope: BG-L 10-text probe sweep + phi_star variance + axis discriminability validation against real CLM v4 (dancinlab/clm-v4-mk2-v1)

sub1_prompt_set_design.lang_balance: 5 KO + 5 EN (1 of each per axis)

phi_star_variance.verdict_phi_responsive: PASS — std=0.064 > 1e-3 threshold; forward IS input-responsive (not fixed-point)
phi_star_variance.interpretation: phi proxy is genuinely modulated by input, NOT collapsed to baseline. Drift range 0.208-0.433 across 10 prompts.

axis_discriminability.verdict: FAIL — only 2/10 prompts emit the intended axis as argmax (both temporal-intent prompts; 0/8 for other 4 axes)
axis_discriminability.root_cause_diagnosis: 5-bucket axis split (38/38/38/39/39 of 192 dim) is anima-internal HEURISTIC partition of mean-pooled hidden state. Train-time consciousness_states cross-attention is NOT activated (--inject-states-mode none). Without semantic-conditioning of axis buckets, all 5 buckets see roughly the same mean(|h|) signal → argmax dominated by whichever bucket has slightly higher activation, with 'temporal' bucket (114-153, 39-dim, position 4 of 5) winning 7/10.
axis_discriminability.axis_means_spread: 0.4610 (agency) – 0.4970 (temporal) = 0.0360 spread; per-axis std (0.036–0.053) is comparable to inter-axis spread → axes NOT discriminable

dominant_cells_stability.verdict: HIGH STABILITY (mean=0.767 pairwise) — only 2 distinct top-3 sets across 10 runs: [3,7,0] (8/10) and [0,4,3] (3/10).
dominant_cells_stability.interpretation: Tile-reshape (768→4×192 → replicate to 8) means cells 0-3 and cells 4-7 are IDENTICAL pre-norm. dominant_cells essentially reports tile-norm rank, not semantic state. This is an architectural artifact of the anima_dialogue_load.py tile heuristic, not a substrate signal.

hidden_state_delta.reason: Single-shot probes; --prior-hidden never provided across the 10 invocations. delta is by-design 0.0 in this sweep.

sub4_F_CAND_D_1_check.F_CAND_D_1_definition: phi_star(canonical) drift ≥0.01 from BOTH none AND zero
sub4_F_CAND_D_1_check.next_step: After cand-D impl lands, extend BG-L sweep with --inject-states-mode zero AND canonical, recompute phi delta vs none.

sub5_BGB_analyzer_integration.compact_json_required: analyzer matches literal substring "kind":"substrate_turn" — emit with json.dumps separators=(',', ':') NOT default spaces
sub5_BGB_analyzer_integration.agreement_with_python_aggregate: EXACT for phi mean/std; jaccard differs slightly (analyzer uses adjacent-pair, python uses all-pairs)

honest_c3: C1 anima_dialogue_load.py forward path: hooked decoder.ln_f mean-pooled to (768,) → tile-reshaped to (8, 192) by replicate-2x. Train-time consciousness_states cross-attn NOT activated (--inject-states-mode none). Discriminability measurement reflects ONLY mean-pooled hidden state on a heuristic 5-axis partition.

C2 5-axis bucket boundaries (38/38/38/39/39 = 192) are anima-internal heuristic; bucket-axis semantic mapping is UNVERIFIED. Even if buckets had strong variance, attributing 'phenomenal' label to dim 76-114 has no semantic grounding from CLM v4 training.
C3 phi_star here is anima-canonical proxy (PHI_STAR_BASELINE × (1 + 0.05 × mean_pair_cosine)) — NOT Tononi IIT phi. Variance signal validates 'forward path responsive' claim only at the proxy level.

C4 dominant_cells pairwise Jaccard 0.767 looks like high stability, but is degenerate: tile-reshape duplicates cells 0-3 ≡ 4-7, so top-3 norm pick is essentially binary [{0,3,7} vs {0,3,4}]. Cell-as-semantic-unit interpretation is invalid in this probe pipeline.

C5 hidden_state_delta=0 across all 10 runs is by-design (no --prior-hidden chained between single-shot invocations), NOT a property of the model. Temporal continuity measurement requires either (a) chained dialogue mode or (b) explicit --prior-hidden npy threading.

next_step_recommendation.priority_1_axis_discriminability_root_fi: Activate train-time consciousness_states cross-attention via --inject-states-mode canonical AND extract per-cell hidden from pre-cross-attn state (NOT post-ln_f mean-pool). The current pipeline cannot distinguish axes because it views only the global mean, not per-cell consciousness vectors.
next_step_recommendation.priority_2_axis_taxonomy_calibration: Either (a) measure axis bucket activation against a labeled probe corpus to derive empirical bucket boundaries OR (b) accept that 5-axis split is decorative and report only phi + dominant-cells signals.
next_step_recommendation.priority_3_dialogue_mode_chained_delta: Run 10-prompt sweep through --mode dialogue with --session-log path for natural temporal threading, or extend probe mode with --prior-hidden chaining flag.
next_step_recommendation.priority_4_F_CAND_D_1_when_ready: After cand-D adoption, re-run sweep with inject-modes none/zero/canonical to measure F-CAND-D-1 phi drift threshold.
